title: Deployment Window Prioritization & Preflight Guardrails for Private/VPC Quarterly Roadmap
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Problem: Private and VPC customers are experiencing variable upgrade windows and unpredictable availability during rollout waves. We need a deterministic way to prioritize deployment windows, run preflight checks, and enforce rollback thresholds so customers on Dedicated/Private tiers can plan maintenance and reduce incidents. This ticket defines the quarterly roadmap slice to design prioritization heuristics, implement automated preflight gates in the control plane, and add deployment-level observability and rollback thresholds for on-prem/VPC private instances.
objectives: Define prioritization algorithm for deployment windows (cohort scoring by region, SLA tier, and risk profile)
Ship preflight gate that validates compatibility matrix, disk space, and KMS access before rollout start
Provide per-deployment observability dashboard and automated rollback thresholds tied to error rate and latency regression signals
acceptance_criteria: Prioritization spec reviewed and approved by Eng, SRE, and Legal
Preflight gate implemented in the Private control plane that runs checks and surfaces failures to ops UI
Rollback policy engine supports configurable thresholds (error rate > 5% over 10m or latency p95 degrade > 30%) and triggers automated short-circuiting of a rollout
Dashboard tile added to Console showing deployment wave status, pass/fail preflight results, and live SLA delta
Runbook and customer-facing maintenance notification template published in Confluence and shared with Customer Success
milestones: 2025-02-21: Prioritization algorithm draft complete and stakeholder sync
2025-03-07: Preflight check prototype (compatibility + KMS) merged in control-plane branch
2025-03-21: Rollback policy engine POC + unit/integration tests
2025-04-04: Console dashboard wireframe implemented and QAed
2025-04-11: Internal dark-launch on 2 test tenants; monitor 2 weeks
2025-04-15: Ship gated rollout + runbook and mark feature release: private-2025.04
rollout_plan: Phased: 1) Internal dark-launch on sandbox tenants; 2) Beta with 3 low-risk customers (opt-in); 3) Gradual widening by cohort priority score with automated gating; 4) Full default enablement for new private instances after two successful waves. Each wave is limited to a single region and capped at 10% of tenants in that cohort. Monitoring will run continuous quality checks with automatic rollback if thresholds breached.
risks: Rollback automation could cascade if thresholds are tuned too aggressively
KMS integration variability across customer environments causing sporadic preflight failures
Console UI clutter if too many signals are surfaced without clear remediation steps
decisions: Use cohort scoring (region tier, footprint, upgrade history) rather than pure first-come scheduling
Initial rollback thresholds will be conservative (error rate 5% / latency p95 +30%) with plan to iterate after 2 waves
Preflight checks will be pluggable so we can add customer-specific validators later
